summary.en: Three skills for products that read human movement — settling artwork-or-tool first, then answering in lumens and milliseconds.
summary.jp: 人の動きを読み取るプロダクト向けの 3 つのスキル。作品か道具かを先に見極め、照度やミリ秒の単位で答える。

mine: Built a 'director' skill (embodied-product-director) that diagnoses whether the work is an experience or a skill-improvement tool before routing to a specialist skill
Compiled concrete technical thresholds — lumens for projection, feedback latency, camera angles — into roughly 96,000 characters of reference knowledge, loaded only as needed
Designed the skills to output design decisions — what to build, rough equipment needs, what to validate first — rather than code
